stories.title: Virginia Democrat Sen. Louise Lucas charged in federal marijuana racketeering case
stories.line: Virginia state Sen. L. Louise Lucas, a Trump critic, faces federal drug trafficking and money laundering charges, which she is contesting in court.

stories.title: PHP flaws were exploited days before patch, alarming Google, OpenAI, Amazon
stories.line: Critical PHP vulnerabilities were exploited days before a patch existed, prompting alarm across major tech firms.

stories.title: France reports first human Shamonda virus case; officials see no public risk
stories.line: A severely immunocompromised patient in France died of Shamonda, a livestock virus, the first documented human case; officials say no public risk.

stories.title: Hackers target PHP flaw as government and business sites go offline to patch
stories.line: A critical flaw in PHP, the code behind many websites, is being actively exploited, forcing some government and business sites offline while they patch.

stories.title: Macron bans some French protests after unrest, limits weekend marches to unions
stories.line: Macron is banning some protests in France after unrest, limiting weekend demonstrations to union-organized marches.

stories.title: Judge orders Trump to give sworn deposition in $10B BBC lawsuit by Dec. 11
stories.line: A federal judge ordered Trump to give sworn testimony by December 11 in his $10 billion defamation suit against the BBC.

stories.title: Russia and Ukraine trade deadly strikes as Moscow agrees to resume peace talks
stories.line: Russia and Ukraine keep exchanging deadly strikes while Moscow agrees to resume trilateral peace talks.

stories.title: Ohio GOP split over Ramaswamy ad attacking Acton's estranged mother
stories.line: Ohio GOP governor candidate Vivek Ramaswamy faces bipartisan criticism over an ad featuring opponent Amy Acton's estranged mother.

stories.title: UK urges households to keep three days of food, water and cash
stories.line: UK government campaign urges households to stockpile three days of food, water and cash for possible emergencies.

stories.title: Musk's Starlink cutoff grounded Ukrainian drones for three days, Kyiv says
stories.line: Ukraine says Starshield throttling grounded drones mid-flight, halting some strikes for three days, renewing scrutiny of Musk's influence over military assets.
